name: Ambalappuzha Sree Krishna Swamy Temple
reason: Travellers seek this major Vaishnava shrine for its daily Palpayasam offering and Krishna legend in classic Kerala architecture with murals.

name: Aranmula Parthasarathy Temple
reason: Visitors are drawn to the riverside Krishna temple whose legends explain the Aranmula boat race and feature rich wood carvings and murals.

name: Oachira Parabrahma Temple
reason: Pilgrims and heritage travellers explore this rare open-air, idol-less temple known as Dakshina Kashi with unique rituals and martial displays.

name: Mannarasala Sree Nagaraja Temple
reason: One of Kerala’s most important serpent-grove shrines — a vast living kaavu with thousands of serpent idols, distinctive women‑centred priestly traditions and fertility rites that make it a unique cultural and visitor experience.

name: Vaikom Mahadeva Temple
reason: An ancient and architecturally notable Shiva temple that is also the focal site of the 1924–25 Vaikom Satyagraha, allowing a guide to link temple ritual and art with Kerala’s modern social‑reform history.

name: Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary (Vembanad Lake)
reason: A flagship backwater destination and protected bird sanctuary on Vembanad Lake offering rich birdwatching, boat‑based visitor experiences and responsible‑tourism initiatives that complement Alappuzha backwater coverage.
